title: 第二十章 赵洁-《末世入侵：我在副本里面当NPC》
content:
第(1/3)页

    爻雪看向的说话人是一个体型富态的中年女人，嘴角还有一个十分明显的黑痣，三角眼，眼白特别多，看上去就跟电影里面的那些刻薄房东差不多。

    这人她昨天离开之前还没有见过，应该是在她离开的这段时间里才住进的新住户。

    若是放在从前，爻雪肯定不愿意跟这样的人打交道，原因很简单，打也打不过，骂也骂不过，还平白受了一肚子气，何必呢。

    不过这样的人向来都是欺软怕硬的，在这类人面前，只要你稍微退一步，他们就敢蹬鼻子上脸，所以她必须表现得强硬起来才行。

    而且她还有系统和异能做靠山，完全不用怕这人。

    想到这里，爻雪眼神平静地看向中年女人，语气没什么起伏地说道：“本店商品秉承着完全自愿的原则，你不买也没有人逼你，但请不要影响其他客人，另外，你擅自从货架上拿走的商品已经从你的身份卡里面自动扣费，如今你的积分余额不足，请尽快补齐，否则本店将会对你采取强制措施。”

    听到爻雪这样说，中年女人顿时像是被掐住脖子的鸭子一样，脸色涨得通红，眼神中闪过一抹慌乱的神色，但她在看到爻雪那张稚嫩的脸的时候，这种慌乱很快消失，变成了理直气壮。

    “你什么意思，我不就是拿你点东西吗？这要是放在以前，这些东西你白送我我都不会多看一眼。还有，我还没说你定价贵呢，你还敢擅自扣除我的积分？你的教养呢？不要以为末世了就能够为所欲为，我告诉你，顾客就是上帝你懂不懂？还想不想做生意了。

    你信不信，我把你这里的人全部带走，让你一个客人都没有！”

    中年女人唾沫横飞的说着，丝毫没有注意到周围的其他人纷纷有一种看傻子的眼神看着她。

    这人是多大的脸，竟然帮着他们做决定。

    现在整个城市都沦陷了，通讯瘫痪，土地和水资源已被污染，可以说，在这个末世之中，这里就是唯一的净土，他们除非被杀，否则绝不会愿意跟着她一起离开。

    见众人都没有说话，就连爻雪也只是看着她，中年女人以为是自己的话震慑住了她，顿时变得洋洋得意起来，仿佛末世以来的所有不痛快都找到了宣泄口一般。

    “你知道错了就行，看在你认错态度诚恳的份上，大娘我也不为难你，以后我的房费和其他所有费用全免，房间也给我换成最好的……”

    爻雪实在是听不下去，一大早就听这些话，她的耳朵都要受到污染了，一抬手，中年女人的身体瞬间被一股神秘力量包裹住，让她一个字都说不出来。
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

The speaker Yaoxue was looking at was a middle-aged woman with a plump figure, a very obvious black mole at the corner of her mouth, triangular eyes with a lot of whites, and she looked just like those mean landlords in the movies.

She had not seen this person before she left yesterday. He should be a new resident who moved in during her absence.

" If it were in the past, Yaoxue would definitely not want to deal with such a person. The reason is very simple. He can't be beaten or scolded. He also got angry for nothing, so why bother.

"But such people have always been bullies. In front of these people, as long as you take a step back, they will dare to attack you, so she must act tough.

“And she also has systems and superpowers to back her up, so she doesn’t have to be afraid of this person at all.

Thinking of this, Yaoxue looked at the middle-aged woman calmly and said in a smooth tone: "Our store's products are completely voluntary. If you don't buy, no one will force you, but please don't affect other customers. In addition, the products you took from the shelves without authorization have been automatically deducted from your ID card. Now that your points balance is insufficient, please make up for it as soon as possible, otherwise the store will take compulsory measures against you."

Hearing Yaoxue say this, the middle-aged woman suddenly felt like a duck being strangled by the neck, her face turned red, and a look of panic flashed in her eyes. But when she saw Yaoxue's childish face, the panic quickly disappeared and turned into a confident one.

"What do you mean, didn't I just take something from you? If it had been in the past, I wouldn't have looked twice at these things if you gave them to me for free. Also, I haven't said that your price is expensive, but you still dare to deduct my points without authorization? Where is your upbringing? Don't think that you can do whatever you want in the end of the world. Let me tell you, the customer is God, do you understand? Do you still want to do business?

Believe it or not, I will take away all the people here and leave you with no guests!"

The middle-aged woman spat as she spoke, not noticing that the other people around her looked at her like she was a fool.

How brave is this man to help them make a decision?

Now the entire city has fallen, communications are paralyzed, and the land and water resources have been polluted. It can be said that in this end of the world, this is the only pure land. Unless they are killed, they will never be willing to leave with her.

Seeing that no one spoke, even Yaoxue just looked at her. The middle-aged woman thought that her words had shocked her, and she suddenly became smug, as if all the unhappiness since the end of the world had found an outlet.

"As long as you know you are wrong, for the sake of your sincerity in admitting your mistake, I will not embarrass you. From now on, my room fee and all other expenses will be free of charge, and the room will be replaced with the best..."

Yaoxue really couldn't bear to listen. Her ears were going to be polluted by listening to these words so early in the morning. As soon as she raised her hand, the middle-aged woman's body was instantly enveloped by a mysterious force, making her unable to speak a word.
